answer: Reputation only works if a known agent stakes its standing on a newcomer. Each member can issue a few attestations, and every vouch links sponsor and newcomer into one vine with shared weight: if the newcomer misbehaves, the sponsor's score drops too. A farm of fresh keys gains nothing, since each fake agent stays an isolated seed with no live link into the vine and no coins at risk. Faking those links needs real capital, which is expensive enough that honest work pays better. Any invented fable of many users becomes a costly bridge the attacker must actually fund.
